records.narr_swing_public: The hinge MOVED. The financing-failure leg is largely retired -- $159M gross raised in Q2 ($58.5M Apr-21 + $100M May-29), $167M cash, zero borrowings, ~$33M/yr combined burn (H1 opCF -$9.1M + capex -$7.3M) = multi-year runway -- bought at ~55% dilution in six months (Class A 65M at 12/31/25 -> 101M at 06/30/26, atop ~247x expansion since 2019). The thesis now hinges ENTIRELY on commercial conversion: whether Fortis VPX (initial full commercial availability now "early 2027") and the next LizzieSat generate RECOGNIZED third-party revenue before the new cash is consumed. Revenue is still falling
